title: Morn Common Semantic Primitives
description: Language-neutral primitives shared by all Morn semantic contracts: object references, source bindings, provenance, and historical-fact semantics. Self-contained by design (no cross-file $ref).

ObjectRef.description: Reference to any object (internal or external). kind is open-world: any external system may be referenced.

kind.description: Open-world resource kind, e.g. asset / work / work_order / capability / site

SourceRef.description: Binding to the external system that owns a fact. The external system remains the source of truth.

system.description: Owning system identity, e.g. cmms / mes / scada / human / sensor

Provenance.description: Who recorded a fact, when, and why. Required on historical facts.

HistoricalRecord.description: Non-destructive historical envelope: records may be superseded/retracted but never silently rewritten. Dual-time semantics: valid_time (when the fact held in reality) vs recorded_at (when the system learned it).

supersedes.description: id of the record this one supersedes

retracts.description: id of the record this one retracts

valid_time.description: When the fact held in the real world

recorded_at.description: When the system recorded it (transaction time)

contract_version.description: Version of the semantic contract the payload was written under
